statement: The ds4#991 PR build (236cb2a) loads only the imatrix file (qwen4exp, no hyphen), not the hyphenated files. The main-model routing at ds4.c:6789 checks `arch == "qwen4exp"` (no hyphen), but the macro DS4_QWEN4_ARCHITECTURE = "qwen4-exp" (with hyphen) is defined in ds4_qwen4.h:8 and used only at ds4_qwen4.c:1244 (the pack-manifest architecture check); the PLE sidecar uses the separate macro DS4_QWEN4_PLE_ARCHITECTURE = "qwen4-exp-ple" at ds4_qwen4.c:1739. Our Q40RoutedExperts file declares general.architecture = qwen4-exp (with hyphen), so it is not routed to the qwen4 config and fails with 'required metadata key is missing: deepseek4.block_count'. The imatrix file declares qwen4exp (no hyphen), so it loads at 100.1 GiB resident. The mtp and vision files (qwen4-exp-mtp, qwen4-exp-vision) also fail. This inverts the issue's prediction: the PR was expected to load the hyphenated files and not the imatrix; it loads the imatrix and not the hyphenated files.

claims.statement: The PR build's main-model routing (ds4.c:6789) checks the architecture string against the literal 'qwen4exp' (no hyphen).
claims.falsifier: If the routing checks a different string (e.g. the hyphenated 'qwen4-exp'), then the routing is not the cause of the hyphenated files failing to load.

claims.statement: The macro DS4_QWEN4_ARCHITECTURE in ds4_qwen4.h:8 declares the hyphenated string 'qwen4-exp', which is inconsistent with the routing's no-hyphen 'qwen4exp'.
claims.falsifier: If the macro declares the no-hyphen 'qwen4exp', then the macro and the routing agree and the hyphenated files' failure has a different cause.

claims.statement: The Q40RoutedExperts file (general.architecture = qwen4-exp, with hyphen) does not load on the PR build: the server exits rc=1 with 'required metadata key is missing: deepseek4.block_count'.

observed.stdout: 3:ds4: required metadata key is missing: deepseek4.block_count

claims.falsifier: If the Q40RoutedExperts file loads (the log shows no such error), then the hyphenated files do load and the finding collapses.

claims.statement: The imatrix file (general.architecture = qwen4exp, no hyphen) loads on the PR build at 100.1 GiB resident, under the 112 GiB Metal ceiling.
claims.falsifier: If the imatrix file does not load (no 100.1 GiB resident row), then the PR build does not carry the lineage that produced our best result.
